brief:
Mahmoud Khalil, who emerged as the face of resistance to President Donald Trump's crackdown on pro-Palestinian student activism, says the movement has succeeded in shifting public perception, according to Al-Monitor. Khalil believes the effort has encouraged a generation of leaders prepared to question established views.

The protest leader's assessment reflects broader claims by pro-Palestinian organizers that campus activism and related demonstrations have altered the political landscape in the United States, particularly among younger voters and activists willing to challenge traditional positions on Middle East policy.

title: Palestinian activist says movement is reshaping US politics
